Keep hidden checks, patches and qualification assets outside repository/.
licenses: Oakridge is private source at the pinned commit; no license file is present.
local_adaptations: tsconfig.json drops typeRoots and excludes the PWA's vitest and vite files.
src/evaluator-build.ts is added as the evaluator's bun build entry.
briefs.test.ts's two updateBriefDebrief calls pass an object, as Oakridge later did; the start commit failed its test and the typecheck.

Fact-shape arm stage-runs: the start tree records each dispatch as a `stage_runs` row (stage, input artifact, session) in place of the `current_session_ref` column planner2 and build share, and the brief describes that model.
Held trees replace the agent's cohort-ref guard in builds.ts with each guard written against stage_runs.
